overview: Skreek is a trandoshan bounty hunter from Trandosha, documented across Expanded lore. Trandoshan hunter who contested Bossk's scorekeeper tallies during Imperial Era lodge disputes.
history:
Skreek rose from Trandosha to become a trandoshan bounty hunter whose name appears on guild boards from the Core to the Outer Rim. Skreek challenged Bossk's Cradossk-backed authority in Trandoshan lodges, turning scorekeeper disputes into public hunt duels on Wookiee contract worlds. Bounty puck archives, Imperial warrant logs, and Hutt contract registries all document Skreek as a contractor who shaped wars without wearing a uniform. Coverage spans all nine saga films, Clone Wars, Rebels, Mandalorian, Book of Boba Fett, Andor, KOTOR, KOTOR II, SWTOR, and Sith Empire-era mercenary markets.

Even before Skreek's career, Trandosha produced hunters, soldiers, and syndicate enforcers whose traditions fed the modern guild system. Trandosha supplied mercenary hunters to Old Republic charter markets and Sith Empire shadow rolls long before Skreek posted the contracts that made them infamous. Old Republic bounty charters and Sith Empire mercenary rolls show how trandoshan bounty hunter contractors were hired to bypass political treaties. Mandalorian foundling laws and Hutt kajidic codes both influenced how hunters like Skreek negotiate payment and honor.

In the modern era, Skreek competed on postings issued by the Empire, the Rebellion, the Hutt Cartel, and independent monarchs alike. Skreek remained active through Imperial guild consolidation, Rebellion-era shadow postings, and New Republic amnesty debates—pucks archived on Nar Shaddaa, Ord Mantell, and Nevarro alike. Post-Endor guild restructuring and New Republic amnesty debates still reference contracts linked to Skreek. Mandalorian-era postings on Nevarro and Mos Espa show trandoshan bounty hunter specialists remain essential to galactic order—and chaos.

Skreek operated in war zones where capture alive paid more than kill, and both paid more than failure. Skreek and Bossk competed for the same Kashyyyk slave-route pucks, escalating Trandoshan hunter feud into Imperial broker attention. KOTOR-era Nar Shaddaa boards and TOR-era Great Galactic War contracts show earlier generations of trandoshan bounty hunter hunters in the same blood-stained market. Jedi, Sith, and clone troopers alike learned to respect or fear Skreek's approach to pursuit and extraction.
significance:

Scorekeeper duel tradition, Wookiee hunt rivalry, lodge political combat, and Trandoshan trophy competition.
